panchanga.sunrise_sunset_method: Swiss Ephemeris rise_trans, CALC_SET bit (empirically verified to return sunrise in this build). Lower precision than the ephemeris planets: the .se1 files are absent, so a fallback algorithm is used. Accurate to a few minutes, not to the arc-second.

d10_convention_note.adopted: R1 (class-based: movable from itself, fixed/dual from the 9th)
d10_convention_note.alternative: R2 (ordinal parity: odd-numbered sign from itself, even from the 9th)
d10_convention_note.note: The previous report used R2, which reproduces it 10/10. R1 is adopted here. Bodies where the conventions differ are listed explicitly, so the reader can see exactly where a cross-check would differ.

vimshottari.balance_at_birth_label: 5.31 years of the Venus mahadasha already elapsed at birth; 14.69 years remain

yogini.convention: Ashvini-nakshatra keyed; 8 grahas, 1-8 year periods; 36-year cycle

ashtottari.convention: 108-year cycle; 8 grahas (Ketu excluded); begins at Krittika
ashtottari.applicability: Classical condition only: Rahu in a kendra or trikona from lagna or Moon. Not asserted here without that check.

chara.rule: period years = inclusive distance from dasa sign to its lord's sign, minus 1

narayana.rule: reverse sign sequence; years = distance to lord minus 1

arudha_interpretation.note: The Arudha pada shows how a matter is PERCEIVED or projected, which is not the same as the actual material condition. Where the Arudha is strong in Shadbala but its rasi support is weak, the image leads the reality; the reverse is equally possible. This report never conflates the two.

AL.definition: How the native is seen and what standing is projected, as opposed to what is materially the case.
AL.read_as: AL falls in the 5th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is MAJOR DECISION MAKING, FAMILY.

A2.definition: How financial standing appears to others.
A2.read_as: A2 falls in the 5th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is MAJOR DECISION MAKING, FAMILY.

A3.read_as: A3 falls in the 11th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is MONEY, CAREER.

A4.read_as: A4 falls in the 12th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is EMOTIONAL PRESSURE, TRAVEL.

A5.read_as: A5 falls in the 9th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is TRAVEL, FAMILY.

A6.definition: Perceived competence in work and contest.
A6.read_as: A6 falls in the 8th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is DEBT, EMOTIONAL PRESSURE.

A7.definition: How the partnership is perceived publicly; not the partnership's actual condition.
A7.read_as: A7 falls in the 9th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is TRAVEL, FAMILY.

A8.definition: Perceived resilience and handling of shared resources.
A8.read_as: A8 falls in the 6th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is HEALTH/LIFESTYLE, PROFESSIONAL CONFLICT.

A9.definition: Perceived standing of luck, faith and teachers.
A9.read_as: A9 falls in the 1th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is SELF, HEALTH/LIFESTYLE, MAJOR DECISION MAKING.

A10.definition: Perceived professional status; this is the Arudha of career, distinct from the actual 10th-house condition and from D10.
A10.read_as: A10 falls in the 8th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is DEBT, EMOTIONAL PRESSURE.

A11.definition: How gains and networks are perceived, not their measured size.
A11.read_as: A11 falls in the 2th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is MONEY, FAMILY, DEBT.

A12.definition: Perceived losses, foreign life and inward practice.
A12.read_as: A12 falls in the 3th house from the lagna, whose traditional domain is COMMUNICATION, PROFESSIONAL CONFLICT.

jaimini.note: 8-karaka scheme with Rahu measured in reverse (30 - deg in sign).

kp.note: KP requires its own ayanamsha and its own cusps; it is a separate system and is never merged with the whole-sign Parashari houses.

ashtakavarga.ruleset: Classical Prastara tables; 8 contributors (7 grahas + Lagna); Rahu/Ketu excluded by the system itself
ashtakavarga.status_reason: 4 of 7 planetary tables are verified against their published totals (Mars=39, Moon=49, Saturn=39, Sun=48). Remaining tables (Mercury, Jupiter, Venus) are not confirmed and were not fitted to their checksums, so the Sarvashtakavarga total is NOT reported: a partial sum is not the classical 337 and would be misleading.

sarvashtakavarga_partial.interpretation_limit: Column sums over 4 of 7 tables. Each sign can reach 32 here versus 56 in a full SAV, so the classical strength bands (25-29 moderate, 30+ strong) DO NOT APPLY. Use only for relative ordering within this table.

yogas.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga
yogas.formation: Jupiter in a kendra (1/4/7/10) from the Moon
yogas.calculation: Jupiter in Libra, 7th from the Moon (Moon in Aries)

yogas.name: Dhana Yoga
yogas.formation: A planet ruling the 2nd or 11th, itself placed in a kendra or trikona
yogas.calculation: Venus rules [2] and sits in the 5th

yogas.name: Dharma / Raj Yoga (Kendra-Trikona lord)
yogas.formation: A lord of the 5th or 9th placed in a kendra or trikona
yogas.calculation: Saturn (lord of the 5th) sits in the 1th; Venus (lord of the 9th) sits in the 5th

numerology.note: Computed from the digits of 09-12-1981 only. Presented separately; not treated as agreeing or disagreeing with astrology.

sade_sati_definition.rule: Saturn over the signs 12th from, equal to, and 2nd from the natal Moon

sade_sati_phase_now.note: Computed from Saturn's actual sidereal position on the report date, not from age arithmetic.

historical_source.detail: Two historical kundali photographs exist on disk, but the vision provider rejects every request (HTTP 401 invalid key). No transcription has been machine-verified, so no historical value is treated as authoritative anywhere in this dataset.
